scope: Keep LibreCAD's entity metadata tests source-compatible with the upstream libdxfrw DRW_TableCellAttribute, whose private retained-text accounting member makes aggregate initialization unavailable.

change.details: Replaced three brace aggregate initializers with explicit assignments to m_attdefHandle, m_index, and m_text. This also remains compatible with LibreCAD's bundled libdxfrw type.

notes: The focused build rebuilt LibreCAD's application library and the entity metadata test target against the clean upstream libdxfrw overlay.
CTest has no registered entity metadata test in this overlay; the built executable was run directly.
A pre-existing Qt Q_OS_MAC deprecation warning appeared in qg_graphicview.cpp; it did not fail the build.

limits: This qualifies compilation and metadata test behavior against the upstream API. It is not a native DWG/DXF semantic, ABI, platform, or full LibreCAD release qualification. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.
